---
title: "Viterbi Algorithm"
---

## Core Question

What is the most likely hidden path?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Derive max-product recurrence.
- Convert to log-space max-sum recurrence.
- Add backpointers.
- Justify $\mathcal{O}(nK^2)$ complexity.
- Compare the structure with alignment dynamic programming.
- Work through a tiny HMM by hand.
- Test one-state, deterministic-emission, and short known-path cases.
- Discuss contribution logs and individual addenda for the triad implementation assignment.
